title: Prepare final abstract-icon update without physical devices
outcome: Freeze WellSpent 0.2.0 (9), validate the exact candidate, and stage its App Store update while physical acceptance remains pending.

included: Allocate build 9, regenerate project and freeze exact source.
Run full CI and inspect signed archive and distribution export, privacy report and upload validation.
Capture candidate-source simulator store screenshots and stage accurate metadata and processed build in App Store Connect.
Record source, simulator, signed-package and external-service evidence separately; prepare remaining physical checklist.
Correct the Settings privacy wording to acknowledge optional Watch notifications and scope the backup statement to iPhone, without changing privacy behavior.
Correct two iPhone erasure messages to reflect retained Watch data and remove the unsupported no-transmission guarantee; clarify the existing privacy preference applies to goal alerts.
excluded: Physical-device queries, installations, tests or data mutations.
App Review submission or public release before outstanding physical acceptance.
Tester invitations, external beta enrollment, public privacy/support copy changes, product behavior/schema/signing identity changes.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A clean exact-source receipt identifies 0.2.0 (9) and generated-project parity.
Full thirteen-stage CI passes on the frozen candidate.
Signed archive and distribution export pass four-component inspection and include the approved abstract icon variants.
Accurate candidate-source screenshots, metadata and privacy reconciliation are ready, and App Store upload/processing status is recorded without claiming physical acceptance.

blocker.resumeEvent: Owner reports 0.2.0 (9) added for review. Resume independent external-state closure when App Store Connect can be read to confirm the exact queue state and candidate. No contact save or submission action should be repeated without first checking current state; outstanding physical/public-copy and report limitations remain separate.
